scope: Prerequisite checks and opt-in local runtime checks. Physical voice, OAuth grants, external writes, and teammate observations need their own evidence.
costNotice: No billable call starts from this harness. A local admission budget is not a provider invoice cap.

checks.detail: Sona returned its own local session. This does not prove a service connection or teammate setup.

checks.prerequisite: An authorized OpenAI project, a supported selected model, dated prices, and actual laptop microphone/speaker access.
checks.detail: Complete the English and Korean voice protocol in docs/verification/live-checks.md.

checks.prerequisite: A Sona-authorized Google account and an explicitly designated test calendar with no attendees or invitations.
checks.detail: Complete the read, spoken approval, rejection, duplicate, and unknown-outcome protocol.

checks.prerequisite: A compatible released Codex app-server, its supported ChatGPT login, and an existing Calendar grant in the selected account.
checks.detail: Prove a same-account read and approved write without a new Google grant. Discovery alone is insufficient.

checks.prerequisite: An exported sona-agent.json and a different authorized local binding.
checks.detail: Operate the example runtime without the Sona study database.

checks.prerequisite: Actual Windows and macOS laptops with current Chrome and physical microphones and speakers.
checks.detail: Do microphone, output, interruption, device-loss, output-selection, and recovery checks. Headless Chromium is insufficient.

checks.prerequisite: A representative researcher and supervised participant.
checks.detail: Record activations, time, mistakes, backtracking, and assistance for the PRD tasks.

checks.prerequisite: An independent teammate with a laptop and their own authorized credentials.
checks.detail: Install the release, run the study procedure, and operate the portable agent. An automated clean install is insufficient.
